news.headline: Datadog Fell 12% on a Flat Fourth-Quarter Outlook. Analysts Raised Its 2027 Earnings Estimate 6%
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog fell more than 12% on Nov. 4 on a flat fourth-quarter guide, as its largest customer, an AI company, cuts its usage to its contract minimum.

news.headline: George Soros and 11 Other Big Funds Bought Datadog Last Quarter, While 13 Sold. Who’s Right?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 12 bought Datadog, led by GQG Partners and George Soros’ fund, and 13 sold, led by Strategy Capital and RDST Capital.

news.headline: Datadog vs. Figma: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: Datadog and Figma pull in opposite directions, one with real profits and one with rapid growth, and the valuation gap may be the deciding factor.

news.headline: Sequel.io Raises $15M to Build a New Category in Video-Driven Audience Intelligence
news.summary: Sequel.io, a video-driven audience intelligence and activation platform, today announced $15 million in funding led by Sorenson Capital, bringing total funding to approximately $26 million. New investors in the round include High Alpha, Album VC and Webflow Ventures, with additional participation from existing investors Javelin Venture Partners, Struck Capital, Alumni Ventures and Social Leverage.
